# Litepod

> Litepod is a self-hosted PaaS. Install it on a VPS or Linux server you control and deploy applications, Docker Compose stacks and databases from one panel. It is a lightweight alternative to Vercel, Coolify and Dokploy.

- Deploy from a Git repository, Dockerfile, Docker Compose file or static upload.
- Run databases from templates on the same server as your apps.
- Runs on Podman, rootless by default. Caddy handles reverse proxying and Let's Encrypt SSL.
- Core containers use about 63 MB of RAM on a fresh install. Minimum server: 1 CPU, 800 MB RAM; recommended: 2 CPU, 4 GiB RAM.
- S3 backups of the control plane with a documented restore flow.
- SSO with OIDC, SAML and SCIM.
- Built-in AI assistant with your own API key, plus an MCP connection for AI agents.
- Litepod Cloud: bring your own server and let Litepod run the control plane.

Install: `curl -fsSL https://litepod.sh/install.sh | bash`

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://docs.litepod.sh/en): install, deploy apps and databases, backups, SSO.
- [Get started](https://docs.litepod.sh/en/get-started): install Litepod and deploy your first app.
- [AI assistant](https://docs.litepod.sh/en/ai-assistant): built-in assistant, bring your own API key.
- [MCP server](https://docs.litepod.sh/en/mcp): connect Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client, with OAuth or a personal access token.
- [Docs for LLMs](https://docs.litepod.sh/llms.txt)
